_how_to_read: One row per domain job in .github/workflows/domains.yml. every_hours: the job runs when its last successful run (measured from the start of that run) was at least that long ago, minus 15 minutes of slack; 1 means every tick. slots_ct: fixed Central-Time slots (HH:MM); the job runs once after a slot has passed since its last success. LIFE-609. Jim's rows: comment 12803. steps: a schedule kept inside one job (LIFE-610: the Recruiters mail step reads new mail every 3 hours and does the full 14-day scan on the first read after 09:00 CT; the job itself stays hourly).
